item.title: 2653 reproducciones · 56 reacciones | DESCARGA ATMOSFÉRICA – Um incêndio numa subestação da Companhia Paulista de Trens Metropolitanos (CPTM), na Zona Leste de São Paulo, causou transtornos no transporte público na manhã deste sábado (12). Segundo a CPTM, o problema foi provocado pelo desarme da subestação depois de uma descarga atmosférica durante a madrugada. Imagens mostram o fogo na subestação, na Rua Bresser. As estações ficaram lotadas no início da operação dos trens logo cedo. Na linha 11-Coral, a circulação ficou interrompida até pouco depois das 8h. Na linha 12-Safira, a interrupção durou até as 8h30. O expresso aeroporto também permaneceu suspenso durante a ocorrência. A CPTM diz que a operação já foi totalmente normalizada. ➡️ Assista ao #JornalGloboNews na TV e no @globoplay #GloboNews #SãoPaulo #trens #CPTM | GloboNews

item.description: In July 2026, Donald Trump removed monument protections from about 2.93 million acres at Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante in Utah. item.title: Niger: Kafra oil block could hold 2.5 billion barrels
item.description: Niger’s oil minister held a press conference on Wednesday to address a key issue for the country: the oil reserves Niger could rely on to fuel its development. Most of Niger’s oil production is currently operated by Chinese companies, but one area — the Kafra oil block — could become a cornerstone of economic cooperation with neighbouring Algeria. Active drilling has begun in the block, with the minister announcing that the zone could hold an estimated 2.5 billion barrels of oil. Our correspondent Harold Girard tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Milwaukee Brewers owner Mark Attanasio to dedicate $2M Malibu property to public after beach dispute
item.description: Milwaukee Brewers owner Mark Attanasio will dedicate his $2 million Malibu property to public use following a settlement over alleged removal of sand and rocks from a protected California beach. The California Coastal Commission called the agreement a victory for public beach access, while the company involved agreed to restore the affected area. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: DR Congo: At least 24 children die in school fire
item.description: At least 24 children have died after a fire broke out at a school in Bukavu, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The blaze reportedly started while children were in class, with some attempting to escape by jumping from higher floors. Adults are also reported to have died, while an investigation into the cause of the fire is underway. Our correspondent Emmet Livingstone tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
